pages.text: Two mods add buildings themed around Create. They give a reason to explore, and their chests drop Create components. Neither needs a special trigger.

$(thing)Create: Structures Arise$() adds, by name, a mine train, a lost train station, a pillager steampunk airship, an air drop, a mini sky village, a crusher crane, a fluid tank house, a witch hut, a bastion and a ruined castle.

pages.title: Train Track
pages.text: Create: Structures Arise includes a Mine Train and a Lost Train Station; see Trains.

These are good places to look for ideas: $(l:transport/trains)trains$(/l) at the mine train and station, $(l:flight/airships)airships$(/l) at the sky village and the steampunk airship. Sky structures are also in $(l:flight/destinations)Destinations$(/l).

$(thing)Create: Let The Adventure Begin$() adds 62 structures with new loot, and a chance to fish up Create items. They include a railroad, oil rig, quarry, bunker, castle, kings castle, and houses in several styles.

pages.title: Brass
pages.text: Create: Let The Adventure Begin adds Create items to its loot and to fishing, so structure runs feed the same metals Create uses.
The oil rig is worth a look for $(l:industry/tfmg_oil)oil$(/l) fans. For loot rules in these chests see $(l:exploration/lootr)Lootr$(/l).
